 Print File photo: Election Commision of India NEW DELHI: The Election Commission of India has revised the schedule for the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Haryana, Telangana, Nagaland, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Delhi, extending the deadline for final publication of voter lists. According to separate letters issued by the commission on October 29, the final electoral rolls for Haryana, Telangana, Nagaland, Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra will be published on November 30. For Delhi, the final publication has been pushed to December 22. Join conversation

 Watch 'We Will Examine': Supreme Court Defers SIR-Form 6 Plea as EC Defends 'Unanimous' Decisions The notice and claims-and-objections phase has also been extended, with revised deadlines varying by state. In Delhi, the period for filing claims and objections runs until November 25, while the notice phase and disposal of claims and objections will continue until December 15. In Maharashtra, the claims-and-objections phase will run until November 25, while the period for filing claims and objections ends on November 13. In Nagaland, the notice phase and disposal of claims and objections will continue until November 25. Haryana’s corresponding phase has been extended until November 20, while Telangana’s will continue until November 26. The commission has directed the officials concerned to publicise the revised schedules and inform political parties in writing.
